invariants.rationale: Percent values should not be negative; (value - min)/(max - min) is 0 or higher if value is within the typical range.
If min == max, we early-return 0; otherwise, the fraction (value - min)/(max - min) is typically less than 1 for normal progress bars.
If not the degenerate case (min == max), result is defined precisely by (value - min) / (max - min).
Division by (max - min) only occurs if min != max, so denominator is never zero.
Unless it's the degenerate progress bar case, result is zero only when value equals min.
